scenes.title: Kabar yang dibawa pulang
scenes.vo: Lo akhirnya dapat promosi. Hal pertama yang lo pengen: cerita ke dia, orang yang tahu perjuangan lo.
scenes.composition: Intimate quote above an asymmetric pair; brick speaker carries one small sand event mark toward a distant listener.
scenes.visual_change: Quote dominates; the shared event emerges later.

scenes.title: Sambutan yang lewat
scenes.vo: Dia jawab, oh, bagus. Lalu lanjut melihat layar. Lo ikut diam, padahal tadi pengen cerita panjang.
scenes.composition: Small acknowledgement high left; listener moves toward a drawn screen at the right while the speaker remains low left.
scenes.visual_change: Attention changes direction, not a repeated quote layout.

scenes.title: Ruang yang mengecil
scenes.vo: Kabar baiknya tetap ada. Tapi rasa senangnya bisa mengecil ketika ceritanya seperti nggak mendapat tempat.
scenes.composition: Charcoal pressure field; one large empty listening space contracts around a smaller speaker, with a withheld connection.
scenes.visual_change: Dark field and negative space replace the two-actor interaction.

scenes.title: Menahan kesimpulan
scenes.vo: Ini belum cukup buat menyimpulkan dia nggak peduli. Mungkin dia terdistraksi; kita belum tahu.
scenes.composition: Observation above a dividing line; a single response is separated from the open question of motive.
scenes.visual_change: Return to cream; horizontal separation with no actor pair.

scenes.title: Capitalization
scenes.vo: Dalam riset hubungan, berbagi kejadian positif ke orang dekat dibahas sebagai capitalization.
scenes.support: Berbagi kejadian positif dengan orang dekat.
scenes.composition: Oversized concept name, then a low three-stage path from positive event to sharing and response.
scenes.visual_change: Typography is the focal object; explanatory nodes unfold later.

scenes.title: Menikmati bersama
scenes.vo: Kesempatan buat menikmati lagi kabar itu, sambil merasakan bagaimana orang dekat menyambutnya.
scenes.composition: Large diagonal actors connected by an extended curve, with the event travelling into the shared space.
scenes.visual_change: Diagram fills the canvas with unequal scale and diagonal distance.

scenes.title: Respons aktif konstruktif
scenes.vo: Respons aktif-konstruktif menunjukkan keterlibatan dan antusiasme: ikut senang, bertanya, memberi ruang buat cerita.
scenes.composition: Three short response qualities stack down the left beside a small listening actor at the right.
scenes.visual_change: Sequential textual ladder replaces the two-actor diagram.

scenes.title: Perhatian yang terasa
scenes.vo: Fokusnya perhatian yang terasa, bukan harus heboh. Suara tenang pun bisa menunjukkan minat yang tulus.
scenes.composition: A large quiet word sits above two close, small actors with a short connection and generous space.
scenes.visual_change: Major scale contrast; stillness is intentional after the concept ladder.

scenes.title: Kaitan dengan kedekatan
scenes.vo: Penelitian mengaitkan respons seperti ini dengan kedekatan dan kepuasan hubungan. Ada kaitan, bukan jaminan.
scenes.composition: A restrained association diagram joins response, closeness and satisfaction; a detached caveat remains below.
scenes.visual_change: Evidence relationship, not a causal arrow or invented numerical chart.

scenes.title: Pertanyaan yang membuka
scenes.vo: Misalnya: wah, akhirnya! Bagian mana yang paling bikin lo senang? Gue pengen denger ceritanya.
scenes.text: “Bagian mana yang paling bikin lo senang?”
scenes.composition: Large invitation quote broken into a readable editorial stack; a small open relational curve below.
scenes.visual_change: Quoted speech leads without additional explanatory paragraph.

scenes.title: Mengakui usaha
scenes.vo: Lalu tanggapi usahanya: gue inget lo nyiapin ini berbulan-bulan. Pasti berarti banget buat lo.
scenes.support: Akui apa yang berarti buat dia.
scenes.composition: Effort appears as a horizontal trace with several past marks and a present actor; recognition text sits above.
scenes.visual_change: Time trace gives the acknowledgement a concrete referent.

scenes.title: Kekhawatiran punya tempat
scenes.vo: Kalau ada kekhawatiran, itu bisa dibahas juga. Beri kesempatan buat menikmati kabarnya sebelum masuk ke risikonya.
scenes.composition: Two unequal vertical zones: enjoy the news, then make room to discuss worries; a curved route connects them.
scenes.visual_change: Order diagram changes the axis and hierarchy of the preceding timeline.

scenes.title: Menyatakan keinginan
scenes.vo: Kalau lo yang cerita, lo bisa bilang: gue lagi senang, mau bagi momen ini sebentar.
scenes.support: Sampaikan apa yang ingin lo bagi.
scenes.composition: A first-person sharing quote sits low beside an outward gesture from one brick actor.
scenes.visual_change: Asymmetric personal statement; one actor rather than a pair.

scenes.title: Refleksi
scenes.vo: Saat pasangan membawa kabar baik, apa respons lo memberi ruang buat ikut menikmatinya?
scenes.composition: Spare reflective question over a low, calm connected pair. No effects or unnecessary exit.
scenes.visual_change: Question leads and deliberate stillness lets it land.

basis: Preserved native-speed speech; measured quiet-region pause placement; integer 30fps scene cuts. Word timestamp estimates reanchored to each measured acoustic utterance; no speech time stretching.
